table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	IssueInvCode=H.IssueInvCode, 
	Date=H.Date,
	Department = (SELECT D.Name FROM Department D WHERE D.DeptCode=H.DeptCode),
	Customer = (SELECT A.Name FROM Accounts A WHERE A.AccCode=H.AccCode),
	Supplier = (SELECT A.Name FROM Accounts A WHERE A.AccCode=H.AccCode),
	SalesPerson = (SELECT S.Name FROM SalesMan S WHERE S.SalesManCode=H.RecipientSalesman),
	CustomICode = I.CustomICode,
	ItemName = I.Name,
	IssueQty = SUM(D.Qty),
	ReceiptQty = 	(SELECT Qty=SUM(RD.Qty) 
			FROM ReceiptHeader RH, ReceiptDetail RD
			WHERE RH.IssueInvCode = H.IssueInvCode AND
				RH.ReceiptInvCode = RD.ReceiptInvCode AND
				D.Icode = RD.ICode)
FROM IssueHeader H, IssueDetail D, Item I
WHERE H.IssueInvCode = D.IssueInvCode AND
	D.ICode = I.ICode AND
	H.Date BETWEEN :adt_startdate AND :adt_enddate
GROUP BY
	H.IssueInvCode,
	H.Date,
	H.DeptCode,
	H.AccCode,
	H.RecipientSalesMan,
	I.CustomICode,
	I.Name,
	D.Icode
